snippet.title: Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster - Release Date Trailer - FGS Live From LA 2026
snippet.description:
A release date trailer for Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster. A classic hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania action game, it's time for revenge! Use your Beastmaster skills to unleash your inner beast, fight with your heart-devouring sword and end the threat to Arborea, you decide the ending.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
